description: Seen from above, an old stone fort stands on a rocky point in a stormy sea. A huge white wave crashes over the thick walls and floods across the wet parade ground, where rows of soldiers in dark uniforms stand in formation, then water pours back off the walls. A sunbeam breaks through grey clouds behind, smoke rises from the chimneys of a long stone barracks next to a small round watchtower, a few soldiers move along the wall, and a small boat rocks in the white water below.

taps.phrase: to crash over the thick walls
to rock in the rough sea
